description: This Java class defines a singleton immutable class 'MessageCommandAckRequestSetter' that extends an abstract setter to add acknowledgement request headers to MessageCommand objects, specifically for handling acknowledgements with 'LIVE_RESPONSE' labels. The class provides mechanisms to check applicability and retrieve the class type it operates on.

classes.name: MessageCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: Singleton immutable class that extends AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter to set acknowledgment request headers for MessageCommand objects, specifically for LIVE_RESPONSE acknowledgments.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of MessageCommandAckRequestSetter.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks whether the provided MessageCommand is applicable for acknowledgment header extension. Always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Returns the class type MessageCommand for matching.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Indicates if bind response is required when adding or removing implicit labels. Returns true.
